lane: ADR-0011 lane 3 — google/ink brush-geometry (mesh) wasm build attempt (V12 codex §11.2 step 1)

strategyMeasured.bazel: upstream is Bazel-only (MODULE.bazel; no CMakeLists.txt anywhere) with heavyweight toolchain graph measured in MODULE.bazel: rules_go 0.59.0 + Go 1.23.6, toolchains_llvm 19.1.0, dawn git_override (patched), skia git checkout, protobuf 34 — a wasm cc_toolchain config for emcc is not provided upstream, so a Bazel emscripten lane was rejected inside the timebox without installing bazelisk
strategyMeasured.chosen: direct em++ subset compile (same strategy as the libmypaint lane): 76 translation units from ink/{types,color,geometry,brush,strokes}, excluding *_test/_benchmark/fuzz/JNI/test helpers and ink/geometry/tessellator.cc

dependencyGraphMeasured.libtess2: NOT needed — only ink/geometry/tessellator.cc and ink/strokes/internal/jni/mesh_creation_native.cc (Android util, excluded per §11.2 rule 2) reference it
dependencyGraphMeasured.skia: NOT needed in lane — grep hits were SkewX/SkewY false positives and one comment; Skia/Dawn belong to ink/rendering
dependencyGraphMeasured.protobuf: NOT needed in lane — proto surfaces live in ink/storage
dependencyGraphMeasured.abseil: REQUIRED at 20260526.0 (MODULE.bazel pin); the ink-stroke-modeler lane's 20250512.0 archives are insufficient (ink 1.1.0 uses absl/status/status_macros.h etc.), so abseil-cpp 20260526.0 (5650e9cf76d3be4318d5fa3af38ee483ddfd5e4a) was built separately with emcmake
dependencyGraphMeasured.inkStrokeModeler: NOT a dependency — ink 1.1.0 vendors its own input models (PassthroughModel / SlidingWindowModel in ink/strokes/internal/stroke_input_modeler/); the bridge selects PassthroughModel so the existing ink-modeler lane output chains in without double smoothing

buildAttempt.apiSurface: imk_generate(pre-modeled points stride-4 f64, BrushTip params, pressure->size behavior) -> positions f32 + surface-UV texCoords f32 + triangle indices u32; noise_seed pinned 0 (deterministic replay)

notes: generationMs includes the full TS<->wasm boundary (input marshalling + mesh copy-out).

mesh density follows brush epsilon: the harness default (size 8, epsilon 0.16) simplifies the smooth 240-point wave to 36 vertices; epsilon 0.05 on the same wave measured 66 vertices / 64 triangles in the standalone smoke.

Vello smoke (tests/visual/ink-mesh-vello-smoke.test.ts) renders the boundary-loop PathIR approximation per §11.3 editing-proxy rules — the mesh body itself is NOT tessellated into Vello paths in production.
Numbers only — gate promotion decisions belong to the blind lab (ADR-0009) per ADR-0011.
